title: POV: An AI That Only Answers Multiple Choice
description:
POV: you found an AI that only answers multiple choice. Jev, from TypeSafe, can't chat or write: it picks an option, with how sure it is, in about a tenth of a second. Its makers say it's 444x cheaper than a typical AI model. Developers use it to sort emails and to guard AI agents.
